main_subject.description: An adult woman with shoulder-length light-brown hair, a calm distant gaze, and natural skin texture.
main_subject.wardrobe: An oversized worn brown leather bomber with a thick black faux-shearling collar, dark knit layer, and plain dark trousers.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Standing close to a shop entrance in three-quarter stance, one hand at the pocket opening and the other arm relaxed.

composition_elements.setting: An aged dark-green wooden shopfront at overcast twilight, with smudged reflective glass, faint abstract botanical display, and small unlabeled interior objects.
composition_elements.framing: Eye-level mid-thigh vertical portrait; the window and doorframe create balanced background structure.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: Window, menu board, products, and signage are blank or abstract: no French lettering, readable copy, logo, or brand.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft cool ambient street light with a faint warmer interior glow, no direct flash.

technical_specs.rendering: Subtle grain, highlight halation, mild vignette, aged-paint detail, natural pores, and realistic hands.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical film-scanned 35mm street-editorial portrait of an adult woman with shoulder-length light-brown hair, a calm distant gaze, and natural skin texture. She wears an oversized worn brown leather bomber with a thick black faux-shearling collar, dark knit layer, and plain dark trousers. Pose her close to an aged dark-green shop entrance in three-quarter stance, one hand at the pocket opening. Behind her show smudged reflective glass, a faint abstract botanical display, and small unlabeled interior objects. Use soft cool twilight street light with faint warmer interior glow, no flash, subtle grain, highlight halation, mild vignette, aged-paint texture, natural pores, and realistic hands. Make every window, menu, product, and sign blank or abstract: no readable lettering, logos, brands, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, logo, readable French text, menu text, watermark, plastic skin, distorted hands, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional identity references must depict a consenting adult. Shopfront and wardrobe references are replaceable and must remove all labels, menus, brands, and text.
